posts.body: Hi everyone, I'm using RPG Maker MZ with the Visustella plugins. I also have CGMZ_CORE which works without any problem, but when I activate the CGMZ_ENCYCLOPEDIA plugin I get the error that I indicated on the screen. I also attach how I have installed the plugins. posts.author: spiderbob
posts.body:
Is CGMZ_CORE up to date? Current version is 1.21.0.
*Edit
Actually worth while to make sure both are up to date. I believe there may have been some changes made to the core a while back that may require both plugins to be past a certain version.
